query:
UPDATE samples
                 SET audio_hash = $2,
                     updated_at = NOW()
               WHERE id = $1
                 AND estado = 'activo'
                 AND eliminado_en IS NULL
                 AND NOT EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1
                       FROM samples other
                      WHERE other.audio_hash = $2
                        AND other.id != $1
                        AND other.estado != 'eliminado'
                        AND other.eliminado_en IS NULL
                 )
